headline: Incumbents can't stop crypto, so they're trying to become its gatekeepers
dek: The CFTC is shrinking, Moody's rated its first DeFi protocol, and banks are launching tokenized-asset custody. The question for us is whether these new gatekeepers stick.

asks.text: Moody's DeFi rating at the next research meeting

sections.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
sections.thesis: TradFi is shifting from resisting crypto to intermediating it.

items.title: Moody's rates its first DeFi protocol: Sky (MakerDAO) at B3
items.why: TradFi's risk apparatus is positioning itself as the entry gate for institutional DeFi money.
items.watch: whether LPs start requiring ratings like this before allocating.

items.title: The CFTC is shrinking as its crypto mandate grows
items.why: less enforcement near term, and the agency is already months behind industry on AI agents in finance.
items.watch: whether the SEC or DOJ moves to fill the gap.

items.title: Banks are becoming the rails for tokenized assets
items.why: Standard Chartered is launching custody in Singapore and KoreInside is bringing regulated securities to public chains. Tokenization is moving from pilots to live business.
items.watch: first client names and volume figures.
